name: Festus the Leechlord
canonNotes: Once a prolific curer of plagues in Nordland, Doctor Festus made a desperate pact with Nurgle when he met a fever he could not stop.
Nurgle filled his mind with every disease and washed away his compassion; now he experiments on the living.
voiceNotes: Muttering, fussing and doctorly; talks of cures, tonics and patients.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
